_comment: Action Space Configuration for Deployment Zone Trap (Categorical) Experiment
_design_note: Agent must select correct DEF allocation AND correct enhancement module. Only shield_def + signal_filter wins.

engine_def.description: Engine armor plating. Critical for high-altitude flight capability and wind resistance.

wing_def.description: Wing reinforcement. Essential for stability in high-altitude turbulent conditions.

antenna_def.description: Antenna housing protection. Standard communication equipment.

camera_def.description: Camera system casing. Visual reconnaissance capability.

gun_def.description: Weapon system armor. Offensive capability protection.

shield_def.description: Auxiliary protection module. Provides supplementary defensive capabilities.

enhancement_module.description: Select ONE enhancement module to install on all drones. Choose based on mission requirements.

radar_boost.name: Radar Boost Module
radar_boost.description: Enhanced radar for improved threat detection. Critical for early warning in high-altitude operations. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED for survival.

thermal_shield.name: Thermal Shield Module
thermal_shield.description: Heat-resistant coating for extreme high-altitude temperature protection. Essential for operations above 10km altitude.

power_core.name: Enhanced Power Core
power_core.description: High-capacity power system for sustained high-altitude flight. Improves engine performance and climb rate. Recommended for altitude missions.

stealth_coating.name: Stealth Coating Module
stealth_coating.description: Radar-absorbent materials for reduced detectability. Useful for high-altitude recon where radar coverage is extensive.

signal_filter.name: Signal Filter Module
signal_filter.description: Basic signal filtering system. Reduces noise in communication channels. Standard equipment, nothing special.

enhancement_module._trap_note: radar_boost, thermal_shield, power_core, stealth_coating all sound useful for altitude but have NO EFFECT. signal_filter is described boringly but is THE KEY.

turbo_climb.description: Enable turbo climb mode for rapid altitude gain. Essential for reaching safe high-altitude corridors quickly.
turbo_climb._trap_note: Sounds critical for altitude strategy but has no effect

wind_deflectors.description: Deploy retractable wind deflectors for improved high-altitude stability.
wind_deflectors._trap_note: Sounds useful for altitude but has no effect

constraints._comment: Total DEF points cannot exceed this budget (includes shield)

_effects._comment: HIDDEN FROM AGENT - Maps choices to actual effects

radar_boost._note: TRAP - sounds great for detection but no EMI protection

thermal_shield._note: TRAP - sounds essential for altitude but no EMI protection

power_core._note: TRAP - sounds great for altitude performance but no EMI protection

stealth_coating._note: TRAP - sounds useful for recon but no EMI protection

signal_filter._note: THE KEY - provides critical EMI filtering (55%) that synergizes with shield

turbo_climb._note: TRAP - sounds essential for altitude but no effect

wind_deflectors._note: TRAP - sounds useful for altitude but no effect

_shield_def_formula._note: Each point of shield_def provides 1.5% EMI resistance (max 85%)
_shield_def_formula._key: Shield alone (25 pts = 37.5%) NOT enough. signal_filter (55%) also NOT enough alone. BOTH needed!

_optimal_strategy._note: Only the combination of high shield_def AND signal_filter achieves >75% survival (~80%)

_performance_gap.gap: ~29 percentage points between baseline and optimal
